structuredContent.body:
## Description

Repairs S2.5-R1: the removal safety scan currently hydrates every member’s email, although its checks do not use email. Successful display reads can consume the 30-second operation budget and leave an unnecessary durable hold.

Stacked on #255. The repair will add a narrow facts-only page on the existing directory, preserve display/direct-target reads and all safety/lifetime/receipt rules, and begin with the failing 100-member regression.

Implementation and final verification are in progress. No deployment, provider settings, database schema or notice publication is included. Expected T2 architecture review because the public directory contract changes; final facts and evidence will replace this draft report.
